name: Thaumaturgy I
description:
Chances to miss reduced by 15%.
Attacks have a 40% chance to POISON the target for 1 turn. Striking an ABLAZE target triggers VAPORIZE (deals 60% INT magic burst to all enemies).

On death, POISONS every enemy for 5 turns and STUNS them for 1 turn.

POISON: damage reduced by 20%
STUN: the unit skips its turn
